title: Build the canonical export-checked E1S DEVELOPMENT kernel and its KPI set with the KRN-041 fixes, reproducibly from main
acceptance: A build tool in tools/build/ applies 0001 to the native pmap.c under the recorded STR-023 recipe and 0002 to the export lists, relinks the STR-041 link once with that object, and publishes the kernel, profile export lists, all-kpi.exp, the seven symbol sets and a hash manifest in one run directory.
The genuine kextsymboltool passes both check_all_exports passes and all seven symbol sets for the published kernel, and the stub machine code is checked; failures are kept in the report.

Two runs in different directories publish byte-identical manifests; the only flag added to the recorded recipe is a source prefix map, and the pmap.o __text is identical to the KRN-041 run-003 patched object.
Nothing is booted, packaged or sent to a device; downstream use is limited to linking and symbol resolution.
steps: Add the prefix map and publish the KPI set
